name: Four-Limbed Staff Pose
description: Low plank with the elbows bent to 90 degrees and the body in one line.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Start in a high plank: hands under your shoulders, legs straight, body in one line.
Shift a little forward onto your toes before you lower.

keyframes.name: Plank
keyframes.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.

keyframes.name: Chaturanga
keyframes.cue: Lower with the elbows hugging in until the upper arms are level.

cues: Stop when the shoulders reach elbow height.
Keep the hips level with the shoulders.
